strategy_question: How should the first authored L03 OPI be validated while preserving the closed dual-realization source package, unresolved translation and all semantic/authority guards?

routes.name: SOURCE_PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_AND_GOVERNANCE_VALIDATION_FIRST
routes.reason: Validate only that the authored curriculum artifact exactly preserves the already authorized source package and governance boundaries before any pedagogical/runtime expansion.

routes.name: VALIDATE_WITH_NATURAL_LANGUAGE_TRANSLATION
routes.reason: Would assert semantics not licensed by the Language Core.

routes.name: VALIDATE_AND_UNLOCK_ALL_L03_OPI
routes.reason: Would exceed the one-position scope and bypass the sequential gate discipline.

validation_dimensions: Exact source package integrity: VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE only.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula inference.
No canonical OPI ID or label creation.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH and KE CANDIDATE/non-generalized unchanged.
No QA, STR003-STR005, global OPI unlock or runtime activation.
